import argparse
from pathlib import Path

import pytorch_lightning as pl

from doc_octopy.datasets.kinematics_and_emg.as_2D import KinematicsEMGDataset__3D_Points
from doc_octopy.utils.constants import EXPERIMENTS_TO_USE

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
    description="Training script for the AI model from Sîmpetru et al.",
    formatter_class=argparse.ArgumentDefaultsHelpFormatter,
)
parser.add_argument(
    "--seed",
    "-s",
    type=int,
    default=1801211219,
    help="Seed to be used.",
)
parser.add_argument(
    "--experimentee",
    "-e",
    default="ERROR",
    help="Experimentee / Subject to be used.",
)
parser.add_argument(
    "--df_cutoff_freq",
    default=None,
    type=int,
    help="Data filter cutoff frequency in Hz",
)
parser.add_argument(
    "--df_order",
    default=4,
    type=int,
    help="Data filter order",
)
parser.add_argument(
    "--sf_cutoff_freq",
    default=None,
    type=int,
    help="Supplementary filter cutoff frequency in Hz",
)
parser.add_argument(
    "--sf_order",
    default=4,
    type=int,
    help="Supplementary filter order",
)
parser.add_argument(
    "--rectify",
    default=0,
    type=int,
    help="Set to 1 to rectify EMG.",
)

args = parser.parse_args()

pl.seed_everything(args.seed, workers=True)

dataset = KinematicsEMGDataset__3D_Points(
    raw_data_path=Path("..", "data", "kinematics_and_emg_new", args.experimentee),
    processed_data_path=list(Path("../../../../../scratchssd").resolve().glob("*"))[-1],
    run_preprocess=True,
    run_splitting=True,
    chunk_size__samples=192,
    distance_between_chunks__samples=64,
    data_filter_cutoff_freq__hz=args.df_cutoff_freq,
    data_filter_order=args.df_order,
    supplementary_filter_cutoff_freq__hz=args.sf_cutoff_freq,
    supplementary_filter_order=args.sf_order,
    rectify_emg=bool(args.rectify),
    seed=args.seed,
    experiments_to_use=EXPERIMENTS_TO_USE,
    experiment_to_use_as_test=None,
    dataloader_parameters={
        "batch_size": 1,
        "pin_memory": False,
        "num_workers": 1,
        "persistent_workers": False,
    },
    shuffle_training_data=True,
    # augmentations_to_use=None,
    augmentations_to_use=[
        ("gaussian noise", {}),
        # ("gaussian noise", {"target_snr__db": 27.5}),
        ("magnitude warping", {}),
        # ("magnitude warping", {"gaussian_std": 0.45, "gaussian_mean": 0}),
        # ("wavelet decomposition", {"level": 4}),
    ],
    amount_of_chunks_to_augment_at_once=250,
)
dataset.prepare_data()
